create_canary_score_auditor: create a CanaryScoreAuditor with held-in and held-out canary attack scores to estimate model privacy
run_epsilon_clopper_pearson: run epsilon lower bound estimation using the Clopper-Pearson method with configurable significance and delta
run_epsilon_one_run: run single-round privacy auditing using the Steinke et al. 2024 method for one-shot epsilon estimation
compute_tpr_at_given_fpr: compute the maximum true positive rate at a specified false positive rate from canary attack scores
compute_attack_auroc: compute the area under the ROC curve from held-in and held-out canary attack scores
